description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'listOrganizations' that fetches and processes a list of organizations (tenants) for the current user from an API endpoint. It normalizes various possible data schemas, sorts the list, and exports the function as the default module export.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches a list of organizations (tenants) associated with the current user, normalizes the data schema, sorts the result, and returns an array of organization objects with 'id' and 'name' properties.
